subject: Fix memory leak in GetCommandKeysWithFlags (#5046)
reason: The fix adds getKeysFreeResult() to VM_GetCommandKeysWithFlags, a module-only API that leaks the heap-allocated getKeysResult.keys array only when a command produces more than 256 keys (MAX_KEYS_BUFFER). It is reachable exclusively through RM_GetCommandKeys/WithFlags, which among all test modules is called only by tests/modules/getkeys.c. getkeys.so is not in the runner's buildable module set, so no loadable module exposes the API; no core command, valkey.action.commands sequence, or valkey.action.tools run reaches it either.
